title: EMG Core v49 Neural Substrate Firebase Blueprint
description: Optimized, type-safe, and resilient schema definition for distributed autonomous agents and substrate state with rigorous defense-in-depth bounds checking.

AgentState.title: Agent State
AgentState.description: Represents the current state and telemetry of an agent in the substrate with strict defensive bounds.

id.description: Unique immutable Agent identifier with strict length and character boundaries.

objective.description: The current primary objective function bounded against buffer overflow injection vectors.

resources.description: Available resource units bounded to safe numerical limits.

energy.description: Normalized energetic reserve percentage strictly capped between 0 and 100.

knowledge.description: Quantified substrate knowledge metric with safe bounds.

cycleCount.description: Total execution loops processed, guarded against overflow.

lastAction.description: Mnemonic of the most recent executed operation with explicit length limits.

status.description: Current lifecycle status indicator restricted to an explicit whitelist.

WorldState.title: World State
WorldState.description: The shared substrate variables accessible to all autonomous agents with cryptographic integrity tracking and strict type validation.

entropyCoefficient.description: Substrate disorder metric strictly normalized between 0.0 and 1.0.

structuralCoherence.description: Substrate integrity metric strictly normalized between 0.0 and 1.0.

globalVariables.description: Extensible namespace for global context parameters constrained against arbitrary payload injection.

lastModifiedBy.description: Agent identifier responsible for the last state mutation with verified format.

lastModifiedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last state mutation.

stateHash.description: SHA-256 cryptographic hash of the entire world state for absolute integrity verification.

AuditLog.title: Audit Log
AuditLog.description: A cryptographic-style immutable ledger of all agentic interactions and state mutations with defensive validation.

agentId.description: Originating agent identifier with strict bounds.

modelCallId.description: Associated LLM or neural execution session identifier.

action.description: Action intent descriptor with enforced size constraints.

preStateHash.description: World state hash before action execution.

postStateHash.description: World state hash after action execution.

delta.description: Computed state change differential payload with type constraints.

outcome.description: Resulting execution status narrative or code.

harmScore.description: Safety gate calculated risk metric strictly bounded.

allowedByCommitGate.description: Boolean flag denoting whether the commit gate authorized the operation.

/agents/{agentId}.description: Individual agent telemetry collection path with strict validation rules.

/world/current.description: The primary singleton shared substrate document.

/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Append-only immutable history collection of agent interactions.
